name: Punjab National Bank
title: Punjab National Bank - 532461 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: PNB ends FY26 with GNPA 2.95% (from 3.95%), CRAR 17.74% and ROA 0.89% hit by a one-time tax-regime charge; NIM guide cut to 2.6-2.7% for FY27 from 2.8-2.9% earlier.

triggers.label: NIM Q4 2.61% domestic, 2.47% global
triggers.quote: our domestic NIM stood at 2.61% for Q4 whereas global NIM stood at 2.47%

triggers.label: NIM guide cut to 2.6-2.7%
triggers.quote: instead of giving 2.8%, 2.9% and showing a very rosy picture and coming down, we thought let us keep that 2.6% to 2.7%

triggers.label: Capital raise dropped; capital 17.74%
triggers.quote: And we are not going to raise any capital
triggers.highlight: we are not going to raise any capital

triggers.label: Deposit rates sticky; cost falls 2-3bp/month
triggers.quote: Of course, 2 to 3 basis point reductions are happening every month

triggers.label: ECL transition shortfall ~INR9-10k cr
triggers.quote: that ECL transition impact of INR9,000 crores to INR10,000 crores, does that broadly number remains

guidance.quote: We expect our global NIM to remain in the range of 2.6% to 2.7% for financial year '26 -'27.
I can see that you are building in NII growth of 7%
We added 144 branches in FY '26 and plan to open 250 more in current financial year.
you're saying that credit cost is below 0.4% is your guidance for FY27

prior_guidance_check.quote: We met or exceeded our stated guidance for 2025-'26 financial year across most key parameters.
you had given a very good target of the NIM of 2.8% to 2.9%, but we have lended up to 2.57%
The only areas of variance were the CASA ratios and margins
For the full year, there is a 9.2% growth, well above the guidance of 8% to 9%.
slippage ratio for the full year is 0.60%
Our PCR stands at 97.14% as of March '26, which is well above our guidance of more than 96%

red_flags.label: Employee cost drop flatters Q4 profit
red_flags.quote: the balance INR1,814 crores has been booked as an expenditure in the employee cost

red_flags.label: Tax rate 26.16% vs 25.17% statutory
red_flags.quote: this quarter 26.16% is our rate against our 25.168%

red_flags.label: Q4 AS-15 treasury gain offsets weak treasury
red_flags.quote: Now my treasury income is very subdued in this quarter

red_flags.label: Management hedged NIM guidance; NII guide 7% vs 12-13% credit growth
red_flags.quote: we have kept this NII at 7% as a conservative level

evasions.quote: for the final number, I think, we just wait for another two quarters
We will see that maybe Q1 or Q2 depending upon the situation
AFS reserves, yes, we'll give you. We'll give you.
